notes: Search totals are cumulative over the coverage window and count individual audit-log searches; they are not comparable to the 30-day search-session figures on Flock transparency portals.
Coverage depends on which agencies' audit logs USA TODAY obtained; a low total can mean few searches or few records.

high_frequency holds the Wisconsin rows among the 5,000 highest 'frequency score' rows nationally (score 63-100). USA TODAY: a high score is not an accusation of wrongdoing; there may be legitimate law-enforcement reasons for frequent searches.
Flock stopped offering customers this monthly audit view in December 2025, so the window has closed.
